stem:
Meena shines a torch through a long pipe in her school corridor to see if the light reaches her friend Arjun at the other end.
In which situation will Arjun see the torch light?

options.text: when the pipe is bent in the middle but the torch is very bright
when the straight pipe is held so that Arjun's eye, the pipe and the torch are all in one line
when the pipe is curved and Arjun stands to one side of its end
when the straight pipe is tilted so its far end points away from Arjun's eye

teacher.key_rationale: Light travels in a straight line, so it reaches Arjun only when the path is straight and aligned: eye, pipe and torch in one line. A bright source cannot travel through a bent or curved pipe, and a tilted pipe misaligns the path, so only B works.
